 Follow Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Lets Fans See New Movie Early as Tickets Go On Sale
 Anuraag Chatterjee Mon, October 26, 2026 at 3:33 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. (Photo Credit: Lionsgate) The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is giving fans a chance to enter the arena ahead of its official release. Directed by Francis Lawrence, the sixth installment of the franchise officially hits theaters on November 20, 2026.
 Tickets for both early-access and regular screenings go on sale from October 28. Lionsgate has scheduled early-access screenings in premium large formats beginning November 18. These include exclusive screenings in IMAX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, ScreenX, Cinemark XD, Regal RPX, and AMC Prime, along with several other premium large formats.
 How to get tickets for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping early screenings
 Showtimes and tickets are available only at theaters participating in the early-access screenings. Audiences can check local availability for booking tickets from October 28.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Lawrence directed the film from a screenplay by Billy Ray and Michael Lesslie. The movie stars Joseph Zada as teenage Haymitch Abernathy. The film follows Haymitch as he competes in the 50th Hunger Games and joins forces with others who seek to challenge the Capitol and President Snow's rule.
 The film centers on the 50th Hunger Games, known in the series as the Second Quarter Quell. Each Quarter Quell introduced a different rule. The Second Quarter Quell required each district to send four tributes instead of the usual two.
 The film is based on Suzanne Collins' 2025 novel Sunrise on the Reaping. The film is the second prequel to the original The Hunger Games story, following The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes.
 Alongside Zada, the cast also includes Jesse Plemons, Ralph Fiennes, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Elle Fanning, Mckenna Grace, Maya Hawke, Whitney Peak, Kelvin Harrison Jr., and Ben Wang.
 Advertisement Advertisement Director Lawrence also serves as a producer alongside Nina Jacobson and Brad Simpson. Color Force is the production company, while Lionsgate is distributing the film.
